highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves graphics performance, platform integration, and resource handling across Android, Linux, WebAssembly, and native rendering.
highlights_body: This unreleased work reduces managed and native allocation overhead, improves Android texture presentation, and makes bundled dependencies more reliable on supported platforms.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh cycle for smoother front-buffered presentation.

bullets.lead: Managed pixel copies are more efficient
bullets.detail: Optimizes managed image pixel copying to reduce overhead when transferring image data.

bullets.lead: Text shaping avoids repeated buffer allocation
bullets.detail: Pools the UTF-32 encoding buffer and avoids native feature-string allocations, reducing allocation pressure during HarfBuzz text shaping.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered streams no longer retain resources
bullets.detail: Corrects front-buffered stream retention so resources can be released when callers are finished with them.
Uses the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux, improving reliability of the packaged native dependency.
Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so WebAssembly native builds include the required WebGPU implementation.

contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved Linux HarfBuzz binding reliability and Blazor CPU sample test coverage
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the WebGPU implementation in the WebAssembly native library
